name: Desktop workstation keeps core controls in one viewport
description: Verifies the primary desktop practice surface does not require page scrolling to reach the mode switcher, microphone, tuner, and pitch trace.
expected: The mode switcher, Start listening button, target setup, live note/cents feedback, and pitch trace are visible together without scrolling the page.

name: Capture tab audio and reduce centered vocals
description: Verifies Match mode can capture user-authorized tab or system audio, route a vocal-reduced backing mix, and retain the capture for later reference analysis.
steps: Select a source with Share audio enabled, then adjust Vocal reduce and Backing
expected: Capture status shows the audio source is active, the processed backing is heard through Pitch Cruzer, and Stop capture ends playback and prepares captured audio for analysis when recording is supported.

name: Phrase mode uses a compact setup sidebar
description: Verifies phrase configuration moves into a bounded side pane while the live monitor remains visible.
steps: Observe the phrase setup area and live monitor
expected: Phrase controls occupy the left side pane with internal overflow if needed, while the live tuner and pitch trace remain visible in the main workspace.

name: Tuner tools reveal secondary controls without expanding page height
description: Verifies secondary tuner settings use the existing workstation panes instead of adding vertical page sections.
expected: Secondary controls appear in the side control pane and the page itself remains fixed to the viewport.

name: Mobile mode switching remains compact
description: Verifies the mobile layout presents concise mode controls and the tuner without oversized introductory cards.
steps: Switch between Note, Phrase, and Match
Observe the top portion of each mode
expected: The three modes are available from a compact switcher and the current workflow begins near the top without large explanatory blocks.
